name: Qoder
tagline: Alibaba's standalone agentic IDE with project-wide context and a Quest Mode.
description: An AI-first desktop IDE from Alibaba built around agentic coding rather than autocomplete. It indexes a whole project to reason over dependencies and architecture, offers a conversational Agent Mode for pair programming, and a Quest Mode that takes a written spec, plans the work, and produces tested, production-ready code end to end. A Repo Wiki keeps long-lived context across sessions.
insight: Built by Alibaba on its Qwen3-Coder model; launched in public preview in August 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Backed by Alibaba's Qwen3-Coder with support for frontier models.

edge: A standalone agentic IDE from a hyperscaler, pairing free unlimited completions with an autonomous Quest Mode that ships whole tasks.
cons: Credit limits on chat and agent use
